functions.name: central
functions.description: Apply the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction to a family of p-values obtained from a previous federated analysis. Contacts no node and reads no data.

arguments.name: p_values
arguments.description: Family of p-values to correct, as {"hypothesis name": p_value}. Entries that are null or NaN are reported back untested and excluded from the family size.

functions.name: central_federated
functions.description: Run a rank-based test on every selected column across multiple organizations and correct the resulting family of p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg. Nodes return only aggregate statistics: per-column moments, a group-blind histogram, and per-group rank-score sums. No raw data is shared.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: List of organization IDs to include in the computation.

arguments.name: group_col
arguments.description: Column name that defines the groups.

arguments.name: columns
arguments.description: List of numeric column names to test, one hypothesis each. If None, all numeric columns are used.

arguments.name: test
arguments.description: Per-column test to run: 'kruskal-wallis' (two or more groups) or 'mann-whitney' (exactly two groups).
